intent: A concise observation or compressed reading, with the personal judgment kept.

register.default: Observational, compact, and allowed to be loose. A Note does not need to prove that it is an article; it can preserve an unfinished thought as long as the distinction between observation and judgment remains clear.
avoid: Summary / Key points / My note as mandatory headings
inflating one observation into a research structure
formal connective scaffolding that makes a short note sound like a translated report

evidence_burden.rationale: A note points at something and says what the author made of it. Verification applies to any claim it does assert, and to nothing more.

limits.rationale: A note that grows past this has become a research piece wearing a note's structure. Reclassify it rather than padding it.

flexibility: Highest of any profile. A note may be one paragraph or three sentences, and headings are usually unnecessary. It may not be a report.
anti_patterns: Inflating an observation into a full report with generic sections
Dropping the personal judgment and leaving only a summary
Using Summary / Key points / My note as a fixed output template
Adding a distribution artifact to a piece too small to carry one

quality_gates.rationale: Low by design. A note points at something and says what the author made of it.

semantic_roles.rationale: Mostly plain prose. Semantic blocks should be rare here — a note that needs three callouts is a research piece.
